children: Overview
China intra-city logistics provider's half-year revenue rose 14.7% yr/yr to RMB11.74 bln
Net profit for the half-year more than doubled yr/yr to RMB349.3 mln; gross profit margin rose to 7.0% yr/yr
Board proposed not to distribute interim dividend for the six months ended June 2026
Outlook
Company did not provide specific financial guidance or outlook for future periods
Result Drivers
FOOD AND RETAIL DEMAND – Revenue growth was driven by resilient food-delivery and on-demand retail demand, lifting intra-city order volume by over 30% yr/yr
SCALE AND AI EFFICIENCY – Economies of scale, lean rider-network operations and AI-enabled coordination lifted gross margin to 7.0% from 6.7%
INVESTMENT FAIR-VALUE GAIN – A joint-venture profit of RMB222.3 mln, versus a RMB0.5 mln loss, reflected unrealised gains after a portfolio company's listing
